text: ສະບາຍດີ ທ່ານຜູ້ຊົມທຸກທ່ານ ຍິນດີຕ້ອນຮັບເຂົ້າສູ່ລາຍການເຕະບານຂອງພວກເຮົາ ມື້ນີ້ເຮົາຈະມາເວົ້າເລື່ອງ Premier  League  ແລະ Champions  League
desc: A man in his thirties with a bright, clear tenor voice. Professional sports news presenter, precise enunciation, upbeat and confident, fluent in English
